groups.label: Network (POP)
groups.about:
## Capabilities
- Terminates agent tunnels at the **POP** and enforces policy on the traffic.
- Resolves names (`sxdns`) and proxies web traffic (`swg-api`).

## Motivation
Policy has to be enforced close to the user. The POP is the only part of the product that runs in every region.

## Owners
- Team **network**.

## Open questions
- Which POP components may call the platform directly, and which go through the gateway?
